summary: Temporal dev server running in Docker is unreachable at localhost:7233. Users encounter 'context deadline exceeded' errors when attempting to connect with the Go-SDK or temporal CLI, though the UI is accessible at localhost:8233. Issue appears after a system upgrade.
userImpact: Developers cannot reach the Temporal dev server running in Docker, blocking local development and testing.
keyQuote: In step 3 of your example: localhost is referencing the admin-tools container not the host machine.
